t: A league of 39 sovereign German states and free cities created at the Congress of Vienna, with a Diet in Frankfurt under Austrian presidency.
Under Metternich it repressed liberal and national movements through the Carlsbad Decrees of 1819 and later measures.
Rivalry between Austria and Prussia paralysed it, and the Austro-Prussian War of 1866 ended it and opened the way to a Prussian-led Germany.
dyk: The black, red and gold flag of modern Germany was first adopted officially in 1848 by the Federal Diet of the German Confederation, the body nationalists regarded as the symbol of reaction.
ev: The Federal Act creates the German Confederation at the Congress of Vienna
The Carlsbad Decrees impose censorship and university supervision
The Prussian-led Zollverein customs union comes into force, excluding Austria
The Frankfurt Parliament meets in St Paul’s Church
Prussia gives up its Erfurt Union in the Punctation of Olmütz
Austria and Prussia defeat Denmark in the Second Schleswig War
Prussia defeats Austria at Königgrätz; the Peace of Prague ends the Confederation

f.capital: Frankfurt am Main (seat of the Federal Diet)
f.founder: Congress of Vienna; Klemens von Metternich
f.predecessor: Holy Roman Empire; Confederation of the Rhine
